City of Encinitas
Youth Commission Regular Meeting
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 4, 2024 -
04:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MAY 1, 2024 YOUTH COMMISSION AGENDA MINUTES
Approve the May 1, 2024 Youth Commission Meeting Minutes
7. May 1, 2024 Regular Meeting Minutes
8.
APPROVAL OF THE AUGUST 21, 2024 YOUTH COMMISSION ORIENTATION WORKSHOP MINUTES
Approve the August 21, 2024 Youth Commission Orientation Workshop Minutes
8. August 21, 2024 Orientation Workshop Minutes
9.
ACTION ITEMS
9A.
Youth Commission Chair and Vice-Chair
Elect the FY 2024-2025 Chair and Vice Chair to serve a one-year term.
9A. Chair and Vice-Chair Election
9B.
FY 24-25 Youth Commission Work Plan Preparation
Review a list of potential work plan initiatives and begin work on the plan and assignment of Youth Commission representatives (maximum of (3) commissioners per initiative).
9B. Youth Commission 2024-25 Work Plan
9C.
FY 24-25 Youth Commission Meeting Calendar
Adopt the proposed FY 24-25 Youth Commission meeting calendar.
9C. Commission Meeting Calendar
9D.
FY 23-24 Youth Commission Work Plan
Vote to approve Work Plan outcomes for Presentation to the City Council.
9D. Youth Commission 2023-24 Work Plan
9D.
FY 23-24 Youth Commission Work Plan
Vote to approve Work Plan outcomes for Presentation to the City Council.
10.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
10A.
Department updates – Recreation Services Manager Hamer
11.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
12.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Items added with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
13.
COMMISSION REPORTS Roundtable – All Commissioners
14.
ADJOURNMENT
